site.description: Site domain without www, e.g. dmv.ca.gov.

service.description: Service name: the page title for page-level records, or the section heading for "how to" section records.

steps_raw.description: Official step-by-step text from the page or section, verbatim (truncated to 6000 characters).

required_documents.description: Required documents and actions listed in the official text.

forms.description: Forms linked from the page or section.

name.description: Form name from the link text, e.g. Application for Disabled Person Placard or Plates (REG 195).

number.description: Form number such as REG 195, or null when none is found.

fields.description: Fillable field labels extracted from the PDF; empty when not available.

pdf_status.description: Result of the PDF fetch: parsed, disallowed_by_robots_txt, skipped_limit, too_large, not_pdf:<http status>, or fetch_error:<error type>. Absent when extractPdfFields is false.

pdf_pages.description: Number of PDF pages. Present when the PDF was downloaded.

description.description: First-page text of the PDF (up to 1500 characters). Present when the PDF was downloaded.

pdf_error.description: Exception type when the downloaded PDF could not be parsed.

locations.description: Mailing addresses and office-locator links found in the official text.

name.description: Label, e.g. the "Mail to" heading or the link text.

address.description: Postal address (lines separated by newlines), or empty for locator links.

hours.description: Opening hours when stated; usually empty.

url.description: Office-locator page URL (only for locator links).

fees.description: Fee-related sentences from the official text; empty when none.

crawled_at.description: When the page was crawled, ISO 8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-10-24T06:20:00Z.
